sourceProducts.description:
For the first time ever, NHL Topps NOW ® will highlight the game’s brightest young stars in a curated set! This 10-sticker checklist features an elite selection of the most collectible young talents the league has to offer.

Your Hero. Your Team. Your Moment. ™

Topps NOW celebrates the greatest moments... as they happen! Only available at Topps.com. Print runs for every set are released in the NHL Topps NOW Archive
Learn About the Topps NOW® Brand

All sales are final. Print runs revealed after sales window expires. Art subject to change. Not responsible for typographical/printer errors. In an effort to mitigate our carbon footprint, shipments may be grouped together within the same order. Large orders may be consolidated into bulk packaging at Topps’ discretion.
sourceProducts.overview:
Includes 10 stickers PLUS one guaranteed numbered or unnumbered parallel.

Look for:

• Unnumbered parallels

• /10 Black Ice Parallels

• /5 Red Ice Parallels

• /1 Gold Ice Parallel

CHECKLIST:

Matthew Schaefer -- New York Islanders

Michael Misa -- San Jose Sharks

Beckett Sennecke -- Anaheim Ducks

Ivan Demidov -- Montréal Canadiens

Ryan Leonard -- Washington Capitals

Jimmy Snuggerud -- St. Louis Blues

Ben Kindel -- Pittsburgh Penguins

Alexander Nikishin -- Carolina Hurricanes

Cole Hutson -- Washington Capitals

Anton Frondell -- Chicago Blackhawks

The processing time for this item begins after the sale clock expires. If you choose an upgraded shipping method, it will only expedite the shipping time, not the processing time.
